name: popr
description: Hear and see a clickable macOS notification when a Claude Code session finishes, needs your input, or hits an error. Click it to jump back to the right window.

sound_done.title: Done sound
sound_done.description: POPR's own low hum by default. Or a macOS sound name (Glass, Hero, Ping...), a full path to an audio file, or none to mute.

sound_attention.title: Needs input sound
sound_attention.description: Sound when Claude waits for a permission or your input. Use none to mute.

sound_error.title: Error sound
sound_error.description: Sound when the turn stops on an API error. Use none to mute.

speak.title: Say the project name
speak.description: Also speak which project finished, handy when you run many sessions.

quiet_when_focused.title: Quiet when the editor is in front
quiet_when_focused.description: Skip the alert when the target app is already frontmost.

app.title: Force the target app
app.description: Leave empty to autodetect. Example: Cursor.

icon.title: Extra banner picture
icon.description: Picture on the RIGHT of the banner. Leave empty for none. A full path to a PNG adds one, or 'app' for the editor's icon. The logo on the LEFT is POPR's own app icon and macOS does not allow it to be changed or removed.

confetti.title: Confetti burst
confetti.description: Throw a burst of confetti out of the banner's mark when a turn finishes. Each project gets its own arrangement, generated from its name.

confetti_size.title: Confetti size
confetti_size.description: How far the burst reaches, in pixels.

banner_style.title: Banner style
banner_style.description: pill (ivory, the default) or glass (a real blur of whatever is behind it).

banner.title: Draw POPR's own banners
banner.description: On by default. Turn off to fall back to macOS notifications, which cannot be styled or animated.

native.title: Also post a macOS notification
native.description: Off by default. Turn on to keep Notification Center history and Focus handling alongside POPR's banner.

summary_words.title: Status length
summary_words.description: How many words of status the banner shows. It has one line, so this is a status rather than a summary.

font.title: Font
font.description: A font family name. Empty uses the system font. Anthropic's own faces (Styrene, Tiempos) are licensed commercially and cannot ship here, but are used if installed.
